description: The report-group PRESENT WHEN clause (§2023:13.18.41 Format 1) — the entry (and its subordinates) is processed only when condition-1 is true, evaluated once per group presentation before any LINE clause processing (GR2); an absent entry is processed as though omitted (GR2b — relative lines re-anchor, absent items leave spaces, an absent SUM entry neither prints nor resets, GR3g). LIVE (P10 Step 13): conditions bind through the ONE ConditionBinder onto the report model; the RWCS engine evaluates per presentation. 2002 introduction. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 report group description entry (§1985:XIII.3.9.2) offers LINE, NEXT GROUP, TYPE, USAGE, PICTURE, SIGN, JUSTIFIED, BLANK WHEN ZERO, '[COLUMN NUMBER IS integer-3]', SOURCE / VALUE / SUM and GROUP INDICATE, no PRESENT WHEN; the 2002 text has the clause, 'If the PRESENT WHEN clause is specified in a report group description entry, the general rules for format 1 apply' (§2002:13.16.39.3 GR1), §2002:F.2 item 104 records 'PRESENT WHEN clause. The PRESENT WHEN clauses allows lines and printable items, or groups of them, to be printed or not, depending on the truth value of a condition' (item 115's report writer list: 'PRESENT WHEN clause added'), and §2002:F.1 item 6 ('The following reserved words have been added') lists PRESENT. 2014 keeps it (§2014:13.18.41.3 GR1).
vcr: 2002 RW addition (§2002:F.2 item 104; PRESENT among the reserved words §2002:F.1 item 6 adds)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRPW1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT RPT ASSIGN TO "vmrpw1.rpt".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD RPT REPORT IS R-1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-F PIC 9 VALUE 1.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R-1.
01 D-1 TYPE DE.
   03 LINE PLUS 1.
      05 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2) VALUE "OK" PRESENT WHEN W-F = 1.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT RPT.
    INITIATE R-1.
    GENERATE D-1.
    TERMINATE R-1.
    CLOSE RPT.
    STOP RUN.
